criteria.originalDescription: A standard ILogger event yields the same schema, automatic identity, value encodings, and exception projection as an equivalent direct core event.
A named EventId preserves its name; an unnamed EventId yields log.message and retains the supplied numeric event identifier in its documented attribute.
Filtered events do not call the formatter or traverse structured state; accepted events preserve the supplied rendered message and available original template.
Unsupported or oversized state follows core rejection/accounting rules, with no partial event admitted to an output.
criteria.amendment: User-directed truncation for oversized valid payload; unsupported retained state is invalid with zero admission. Per-output partial acceptance under queue/fault conditions remains the existing Core contract.

criteria.originalDescription: The new bridge references the core; the core's public API and compiled dependency graph remain independent of Microsoft.Extensions types.
criteria.amendment: User selects one CIS.Core package/assembly with provider in CIS.Logging.MicrosoftLogger and explicitly approved Microsoft-maintained NuGets; direct CIS.Logging API remains independent of Microsoft types outside the adapter namespace.

comparisonNormalization.name: validated-capture-timestamp-only
comparisonNormalization.rule: Each record timestamp must first be valid seven-fraction UTC text/calendar time; exclude only timestamp for equivalent direct/provider record comparison. All remaining fields/types compare strictly.
